description: Return the full TEXT of a Folketinget (Danish Parliament) document -- a minister's final answer to a committee question (udvalgsspørgsmål, svar på spm.), a bill text, a citizen's petition or letter to a committee (henvendelse, bilag), a consultation reply. Identify it by its numeric Dokument id OR by the Folketinget website address of its file or question. Resolves the Dokument record, fetches its published file and extracts the text (PDF or Word; the declared file format is not trusted, the bytes are sniffed). Returns title, date, the question wording (spørgsmålsordlyd), who answered/asked, the extracted text, the list of files on the record, and a `reason` when no text could be read (file missing, scanned image, unsupported type) so an empty text is never ambiguous. A text whose fonts could not be decoded carries a text_quality_degraded warning. Long texts are paged with offset/max_chars. For a question together with its answer as one record use folketinget_dk_get_question_answer. Source: Folketinget, parliamentary document register.

document_id.description: Numeric Dokument id, e.g. 1237262 (the id used by get_entity_by_id with entity "Dokument"). Give this or url.

file_id.description: Id of one file on a document that has several (see `files` in the response). Default: the newest public file.

max_chars.description: Max characters of text to return (default 100000, max 400000).

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted text, for paging a long document (default 0).

url.description: A Folketinget website document address (the file, or a /spm/<n>/ question address), whose path looks like /samling/20252/almdel/eru/spm/140/svar/2241874/3203803.pdf. Used when document_id is not given.

name: document_text

found.description: False when no document has that id

question_wording.description: Danish wording of the parliamentary question, when the document answers one

reason.description: Why no text was returned (document_not_found, no_file, file_fetch_failed, file_blocked, no_extractable_text, unsupported_file_type, ...)

text.description: Extracted document text; null when reason is set

title: Document Text
